scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,nlp -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter api start:dev" "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm run dev:nlp"
scripts.dev:nlp: cd apps/nlp && (source venv/bin/activate || venv\Scripts\activate) && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 12589 --reload
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter web test
